note: Every image the site can display, and where it came from. Drive is the source of truth for Masinloc photography: assets/ holds only files supplied by the project. scripts/check-photography.py fails the build if a page references an image that is not listed here, or if any page pulls an image from an external host.
rules: No stock photography: Unsplash, Pexels, Shutterstock, Getty or similar.
No image may be relabelled as a place it does not show.
Presentation may be improved by cropping, overlay, layout, typography, motion and colour treatment. The physical identity of a place must not be altered.
